edges.subject: CLN7
edges.quote: Cln7, a major facilitator superfamily domain-containing protein, is affected in a late infantile-onset form of NCL.

edges.subject: neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis
edges.object: early onset in infancy or childhood
edges.quote: The neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses (NCLs) are a group of fatal, monogenic neurodegenerative disorders with an early onset in infancy or childhood.

edges.subject: CLN7
edges.quote: In a Cln7 mutant, synapses fail to develop fully leading to reduced function and behavioral changes with dysregulation of TOR activity.

edges.subject: CLN7
edges.quote: Here we demonstrate that Cln7 is required for the normal growth of synapses at the Drosophila larval neuromuscular junction.
